title: Agent Loops: Token Cascades & Infinite Loop Guards

scenes.narration: An agent loop resends the whole transcript on every step. Each tool result makes the next prompt bigger, so cost compounds. That is a token cascade.
This toy agent gets stuck calling the same search. Three guards sit between the model and the tool: a repeat limit, a token budget, and a hard step cap.
Unguarded, twelve steps burn sixteen thousand tokens and nothing stops it. Guarded, the third identical call trips the repeat guard at thirty-five hundred.
Guard every loop. Cap steps, budget tokens, and detect repeats before the tool runs, not after the bill arrives.
